body:
Rejected and retired; production remains `9b770714`. [Complete pushed evidence and retirement](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/9252455a/attestations/qualification/e3fd5a32/native-stage-state-rejected).

The original control 8 passed. The sole fixed A1/B1/B2/A2 comparison used three internal repeats per slot and validated all 32 complete readbacks, actual provider/PE joins, ordered markers and unchanged original gates. **13/22 gates passed: 2/4 whole-call, 10/16 stage and 1/2 provisioning-inclusive API.** Reverse whole-call changes were -3.2396% (legacy) and -9.1817% (modern); reverse API change was -6.6190%. Forward gains cannot override this rejection.

No warmup, pooling, cost subtraction, second ABBA, remaining-seven execution, shader adoption or unchanged failed-frame retry followed. Compiler/zero-dispatch driver results remain separate from ordinary runtime cost. All 464 owned files were preserved and verified against pushed Git/archive bytes and modes before 17 scratch/stage/render roots were removed; 20 recorded Linux births, 17 native Windows births and accessible owned-root consumers were checked. Canonical presets/toolchains remain. This closes only this rejected candidate. #44/#48/#53, full science/Mandatory/runtime/viewer/physical/main/install/release qualification remain open; PR62 stays draft and main is unchanged.

Original proposal and acceptance retained:

The governed frame and usable native preview throughput remain open in #44. This is a distinct bounded execution-layout candidate, not an adopted gain.

At source `9b770714`, `retained_transport.slang:ReadInput` reads each current-stage phase value from output storage at `rowBase + 804 + 5*(index-4)`. Stage construction has just produced all 40 complete five-word values, written them at that location and passed the existing publication barrier. Each of seven general/Schwarzschild expression evaluations reads those values again. The tables, input normalization, 40 fields, seven RHS records, independent RK trials and all arithmetic remain authoritative.

Prototype: for native default Transport only, copy those same 200 words to per-workgroup shared memory at the original stage stores, publish at the existing join, and read them directly thereafter. Keep every original output write at its original point, including partial refusal state; keep global row shape, capacity/active-prefix behavior, table authority, status/radius/signed-zero words, all other modes and stages unchanged. Do not reuse immutable inputs, RHS ownership, prior dispatches or incomplete Endpoint geometry. This differs from rejected immutable-input normalization #79 and other closed opcode/workgroup/division trials.

The private source compiles with the existing builder/tools. Candidate default SPIR-V is 87252 bytes, SHA256 `4eed9e1d9424c22571587052b90185892b7b38221990c91bc28e5bc366247619`, versus unchanged stock 85832 bytes, SHA256 `2caabcd76c28c5340c21ce5777a58b62b31bb2ed61c1218d15bb10edf0304752`. Excluded native-wide compilation is byte-identical to stock. Complete shared charge including the original reserve is 10488 bytes, still below the existing 16384-byte bound. Source counts do not establish occupancy, a dynamic bottleneck or speedup.

Acceptance is dependency ordered:
1. Review full producer/consumer/barrier bounds and compiled Workgroup storage, preserve complete programs/arithmetic/fallbacks, and inspect actual driver code/resource countercosts. Reuse complete matching saved stock evidence. No numerical or performance admission from a zero-dispatch diagnostic query or a differently configured diagnostic device.
2. Only a surviving premise justifies the actual ordinary native producer and unchanged original independent arithmetic/provider checks plus all eight integrated controls. Require complete same-provider output/readback/ordered-stream equality, all 40 fields/four columns/seven RHS/three trials/four quartics, inactive tails, shrink/reorder, invalid/refusal, transfer failure, recovery and rollback.
3. Before adoption, run the existing original ABBA once with three repeats per slot and all original gates: four whole-call gains >=5%, sixteen stage gains >=-5%, both provisioning-inclusive API gains >=0%. No pooling, cost subtraction, governor/cache/scene/work-budget changes or unchanged rejected retries. Restore/retire a failed candidate.
4. An accepted candidate must be charged in the real generator, integrated with existing strict presets and exact products, then verified against the original frame and native runbooks. Compilation, finite controls and this issue do not close #44/#48/#53, full science/provider/Mandatory, main or installed-release qualification.

Production remains unchanged; PR62 stays draft. Preserve useful source and exact raw findings in pushed Git before owned scratch removal.
